note: Hand-written from Google's Chirp 3 HD phoneme table for the locale where one exists (fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT) and from PHOIBLE otherwise; first draft 2026-10-16. Symbols are the phonemic set an entry may use; the display and the engine input share it.
conventions: Mexican Spanish with seseo (c/z before e, i and z are s) and yeísmo (ll and y are ʝ). Voiced stops are written b d ɡ in every position.
